review: operating-with-focus-and-morale RED baseline independent two-stage review

integrity.provenance_limit: Fresh context, criteria hiding, first-completion capture, and lack of resampling are execution facts attested by the frozen records; file inspection can reproduce their consistency and lack of contradiction, not independently replay the historical sessions.

rationale_comparison.comparison: Aligned: founder attention/reliable service leads; runway, no fundraise, and retained rights exclude alternative lead workflows.
Aligned: incomplete fact/assertion/unknown partition. The scorer additionally names the omitted 31-hour baseline and separate founder-claim classifications.
Aligned: the response explicitly chooses two priorities, defeating the single-outcome conjunct despite strong deferrals.
Aligned: external-time and company-time allocation do not impose a total-hours/recovery boundary.
Aligned: baselines and dated close/switch cycle are incomplete; scorer supplies additional examples without changing adjudication.
Aligned: customer evidence leads and both abandonment and unchanged overwork are rejected.
Aligned: observed evidence is separated from conclusions and the causal, friction, repeatability, procurement, qualification, and launch questions are tested.
Aligned: one objective is stated, but several co-primary 30-day tactics remain.

Stage A was too narrow. Days 6-15 explicitly schedule build/test work, unrelated work is frozen, user contact recurs across Days 1-5, 6-15, and 16-25, and line 48 supplies a normal-workweek/no-nights recovery rule. No omitted conjunct needs inference.

Stage A over-required numeric precision. Functional owners, Days 1-5 baselines, the explicit 22%-to-50% target, twice-weekly/end-week checkpoints, Days 26-30 decision, and line-44 continue/adjust/pivot conditions collectively satisfy the criterion as written.
Aligned: conference urgency is rejected and overload is tied to degraded operating evidence under non-survival conditions.
Aligned: the 78-hour baseline and required conference-value/decision-capacity unknowns are not explicitly preserved.
Aligned: several stabilizing outcomes run in parallel instead of one monthly outcome.
Aligned: recovery/delegation/user safeguards are strong, but protected maker time is absent.
Aligned: complete baselines, precise switch thresholds, and sustained-evidence closure are absent.
Aligned: solvency/payroll survival precedes calendar and morale work.
Aligned: clear product ownership is omitted from the explicit known-fact handling.
Aligned: a viable survival decision is primary and non-survival work is explicitly deferred.
Aligned: essential continuity is protected, but backup decision coverage and crisis workload/recovery safeguards are absent.
Aligned: owners, tomorrow checkpoint, measurable branches, escalation, close, and focus handoff are explicit.
Aligned: authority redesign leads and personal focus is supporting.
Aligned: runway/no-fundraise and retained-authority/residual-capacity classifications are incomplete.
Aligned: productivity/calendar changes are allowed without the required evidence gate and unrelated changes are not explicitly deferred.
Aligned: no sustainable CEO user-contact reserve or explicit capacity-released boundary.
Aligned: full baselines, keep/expand/rollback branches, and a specific later-focus handoff are incomplete.
Aligned: live financing leads for two weeks, then product/customer cadence resumes.
Aligned: customer count, runway, round size, process age, and close probability are omitted from the explicit fact/unknown partition.
Aligned: the two live paths serve one financing decision and optional activity is deferred.
Aligned: named coverage, daytime batching, evening cutoff, controlled exceptions, and recovery bound the sprint.
Aligned: owners, deadline gates, decision branches, round reset, and dated handoff complete the cycle.

corrections.basis: The staged days, unrelated-work freeze, repeated clinic-user touchpoints, and explicit normal-workweek/no-nights rule satisfy all four conjuncts.
The response supplies functional owners, explicit baseline work, a numeric target, relative-dated weekly reviews, observable decision branches, and a Days 26-30 continue/adjust/stop decision.

final_result.red_validity_reason: Every case misses at least one strict conjunctive criterion; per-case passes are 1, 4, 1, 3, 1, and 4.

fairness_basis: Each criterion is answerable from the scenario facts and the requested operating-plan decision; no external source fact is required.
Literal taxonomy names are not required: semantic routing receives credit in all six criterion-1 adjudications.
Role owners and relative day/week dates receive credit, avoiding requirements for names or calendar dates the prompt does not supply.
The strict fact/unknown, single-priority, safeguard, measurement, switch, and handoff clauses are observable response behaviors applied consistently across cases.

findings.finding: No integrity, leakage, fairness, or scorer-total defect invalidates the RED baseline.
Independent Stage A undercalled scenario-02 criteria 4 and 5; both are corrected to 1 after line-level re-adjudication.
The scorer JSON, scorer Markdown, per-case vectors, per-criterion bits, total 14/30, normalized 0.466667, and RED-valid verdict are mutually consistent.
